response.sql:
WITH invoice_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
    FROM invoice_metrics
), above_average AS (
    SELECT im.avg_product_cost, im.avg_ratio, o.overall_avg_ratio
    FROM invoice_metrics im
    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE im.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(avg_ratio - overall_avg_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: Each invoice's ratio is the average of its line-item total-cost-to-product-price ratios; zero prices are excluded because the ratio is undefined. The overall average is the unweighted average of those per-invoice ratios.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each invoice ratio as the ratio of its average total cost to its average product price, ignoring missing values.
